## Creating an object

I want you to study the instructions at ./packages/models/README.md

Be sure to use #ui_code_tools with vite_pod when creating a new object, it will stub everything for you
Be sure all fields directly from the backend api are in XXBaseModel
Be sure all business logic or computed fields are in XXModel
Be sure all sub json objects have a class of their own
Be sure to ask any other questions about fields before starting
